## Decisions
- ScrubberMarks shows marks on BOTH Program and Source tabs (not Source-only as the plan text said) → because Premiere shows marks in both monitors; recorded as a deliberate departure in the DONE log.
- `X` (Mark Clip) and `/` (Mark Selection) and the Sequence ▸ In/Out menu items stay sequence-only regardless of monitor focus → matches Premiere (only I/O/Shift/Alt variants + Play/Clear follow focus).
- A stale/empty marked range (e.g. after a relink to shorter media) falls back to the whole media rather than erroring → same permissive fallback style as other stale-mark handling in the codebase.
- Bin drag of a marked item now overwrites/places only the marked range instead of the whole file → flagged as a behavior change in FEATURES.md (row marked 🟡 stale) since `media/importing-media.md` user docs need a follow-up edit (deferred to phase 6 per the original plan).
